checks.label: Duplicate payment verification
checks.detail: 2203 high-confidence groups (£32.9M). Duplicate ratio: 0.4%. Filtered out: 1185 batch payments, 59486 CSV overlaps.

checks.label: Split payment analysis
checks.detail: 329 suspect instances (£65.8M, 3.8% of spend). Threshold: 5+ payments to same supplier in same week, 80%+ of approval limit.

checks.label: Year-end spike verification
checks.detail: Highest spike: 1.6x in Schools and Education DSG. Year-end spikes are common in public sector (capital programmes, grants). Only extreme spikes (>3x) warrant concern.

checks.label: CH compliance — pre-breach only
checks.detail: 15 suppliers have current breaches, but all payments were made before breaches started. Not violations at time of payment.

checks.label: Benford's Law forensic screening
checks.detail: Significant deviation from Benford's Law (p < 0.001). χ²=3057.31 on 358753 amounts >£100. Largest deviation: digit 1 (3.6% off expected).

warnings: Benford's Law analysis shows significant deviation (χ²=3057.31). Digit 1 deviates 3.6% from expected. This warrants investigation but can also occur with legitimate round-number grants or threshold-based payments.
